user.title: KMA Weather
user.description: This base setup requires the KMA Short Forecast API (기상청_단기예보 조회서비스). Enter that API key and choose a zone entity. The integration reads the zone latitude/longitude, converts it to KMA grid coordinates, and then asks you to pick one of the three nearest KMA administrative area candidates.

area_choice.title: Choose KMA area
area_choice.description: Select one of the three nearest KMA administrative area candidates for living weather indices.

init.title: KMA Weather options
init.description:
Control failure tolerance and enable or disable API groups. The base KMA API key is reused for all supported add-on groups. Group bundles create all related sensors automatically, and disabled groups remove their related sensors after reload.
